cards.name: Fertilid
cards.oracle_text:
This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
{1}{G}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: Target player searches their library for a basic land card, puts it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffles.

rulings.comment: Although the targeted player doesn't need to find a basic land card if they don't want to, that player must shuffle their library.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
